as_told.title: Air Force closes Project Blue Book

plain: Robert Salas, a former US Air Force officer, says that when the Air Force shut down Project Blue Book, its UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, in 1969, it pointed to the Condon investigation, a scientific study of UFOs led by physicist Edward Condon, as its reason. He tells it to suggest the closing was a way for the Air Force to get out of the subject.
